name: Noir
description: A monochrome, quiet-luxury fashion theme. Full-bleed editorial imagery, a high-contrast serif display face and generous negative space — built for considered wardrobes and premium apparel labels.

settings.heading: Quiet luxury, made to endure
settings.body: We design in restraint — clean lines, natural fibres and a palette that never dates. Every piece is cut to be worn for years, not weeks.

settings.heading: Cut with intention
settings.body: Patterns refined over dozens of fittings, seams finished by hand, fabrics chosen to soften — not fade — with wear. This is slow fashion, made deliberately.

blocks.quote: The finest tailoring I own. Understated, impeccable, and it only looks better with age.

blocks.heading: Lifetime repairs

settings.heading: A studio, not a factory
settings.body: Noir began in a single room with two cutting tables and a simple belief: that clothing should be made slowly, by people who care, from materials worth keeping. A decade on, little has changed but the scale.

settings.heading: Materials with a memory
settings.body: We source natural fibres from mills we've worked with for years — wool that breathes, cotton that softens, linen that ages beautifully. No blends we can't explain, no shortcuts we can't stand behind.

blocks.question: How do your pieces fit?
blocks.answer: Our cuts are true to size with a relaxed, tailored drape. If you're between sizes, size down for a sharper silhouette or up for ease. Each product page lists exact garment measurements.

blocks.question: How should I care for natural fibres?
blocks.answer: Cold hand-wash or dry-clean wool and linen; machine-wash cotton on a gentle cycle and lay flat to dry. Care details are printed on every label and on the product page.

blocks.question: What is your returns policy?
blocks.answer: Return any unworn piece within 30 days for a full refund — shipping both ways is on us. Made-to-order items can be exchanged for size within 14 days.

blocks.question: Do you ship internationally?
blocks.answer: Yes — we ship insured to over 40 countries with duties calculated at checkout, so there are no surprises on delivery.

blocks.question: Do you offer repairs?
blocks.answer: Always. Anything we've made can be brought back for repair or restoration for the life of the garment.
